title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 125 (Rights of indemnity-holder when sued)

content.overview: Section 125 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 is headed "Rights of indemnity-holder when sued". This catalog record identifies the provision. The enacted text, amendment status and any case law must be checked against the official India Code text before reliance.

examples.body: Facts that satisfy the elements stated in the provision produce the consequence described in the text.
